C0190.title: Criminal Gang Used Thousands of Phones to Generate Tens of Millions of Fake Views
C0190.summary: In November 2023, police uncovered a case where a criminal gang used over a thousand phones to generate fake traffic for short videos and livestreams. The gang deployed group-controlled devices to create tens of millions of fake views at a cost of only 30 yuan, with video editing and copywriting labor totaling 150 yuan, severely disrupting platform data integrity.
